claims.statement: OpenCode disclosed on October 17, 2026 that an intruder reached a legacy system behind its hosted Console on the night of October 16, affecting 1.4% of Console users who had linked an outside AI provider.
OpenCode's notice to affected users said the earliest possible key exposure was October 17, 00:30 UTC.
Wiz reports OpenCode attributed the incident to a distillation attempt and reported signs of an agent swarm attack.

claims.statement: Wellington IT, a Belfast provider of software to 50 credit unions (43 in Ireland), notified customers of a potential breach in November 2026.
Wellington IT said malicious requests came from an automated client using a valid member login and accessed saved payee records.
BleepingComputer reports the activity ran October 2-4, 2026; The Irish Times reports a weakness in the online banking platform exploited on October 6.

unresolvedQuestions: Primary source needed: Wellington IT has not published a public statement; facts come from its letters as quoted by press.
Dates conflict (Oct 2-4 vs Oct 6); keep both attributed.
Sales angle caution: a valid member login plus an authorization weakness, not a leaked secret.

claims.statement: OpsShield's advisory, as quoted by BleepingComputer, says an attacker used compromised credentials on November 2, 2026 at 02:06 UTC to reach its update distribution infrastructure and push a malicious script through the cPGuard update channel; versions 5.88.12 to 5.88.19 were affected.
Help Net Security reports OpsShield's account that the attacker probed its billing portal the day before the update infrastructure was compromised.
About 2,950 servers ran the poisoned update, which collected sensitive files and installed a hidden root shell; OpsShield revoked the compromised credentials and shipped corrective versions.

unresolvedQuestions: Primary source needed: OpsShield's own advisory was not fetched; facts come from coverage that quotes it.
OpsShield's account changed as its investigation went on (per CSA); recheck the latest advisory before review.
Unknown: how the initial credentials were obtained.
